experiment_data.hypothesis: 在误分类率与真实 CATE 异质性正相关的分类 effect modifier 场景中， pooled/global confusion-matrix correction 会对高效应高误差子群欠校正并对低效应低误差子群过校正，因此 PEHE/GATE bias 可劣于 uncorrected；而 subgroup-specific EC-HTE-lite correction 能通过分层误分类估计降低 PEHE/GATE bias 并改善 95% CI coverage。
experiment_data.notes: MVP design: semi-synthetic categorical modifier DGP with k=3 groups, N=5000, replications=100 initially. Scenarios: positive-correlation worst-case (misclassification [0.30,0.15,0.05], true CATE [0.50,0.25,0.05]) and negative/sanity best-case (misclassification [0.05,0.15,0.30], true CATE [0.50,0.25,0.05]). Compare uncorrected, global correction, subgroup correction/EC-HTE-lite with pilot expert labels B=500. Metrics: PEHE, GATE bias/RMSE, subgroup CATE bias, empirical 95% CI coverage, CI width. Pass: in positive scenario global PEHE or GATE bias > uncorrected, and subgroup/EC-HTE-lite improves PEHE/GATE bias >=20% vs global or improves CI coverage toward 0.95; sanity scenario should not show EC-HTE-lite catastrophic degradation (<10% worse PEHE than best baseline). Estimated runtime: CPU 10-30 min for 100 reps if sklearn/numpy only; GPU optional/not required for MVP unless causal forest implementation uses GPU. Output: results.json/csv + plots + reproducibility metadata.
